stem_bark.text: The bark of Ziziphus oenopolia is greyish-coloured and densely lenticellate. Ziziphus oenopolia is very thorny, it is armed with numerous and sharp prickles.

seed.text: The seed of Ziziphus oenopolia is enclosed into a globose and very hard stone . The stone is wrinkled, brownish-coloured and about 5 mm across. It contains one seed.
seed.text_html: The seed of Ziziphus oenopolia is enclosed into a globose and very hard stone. The stone is wrinkled, brownish-coloured and about 5 mm across. It contains one seed.

fruit.text: The fruit of Ziziphus oenopolia is a globose drupe. The fruit is about 8 mm across with a 1.5 mm long peduncle. It is shiny and black-coloured when ripe and it contains 1 stone.

flower.text: The flowers of Ziziphus oenopolia are grouped in short axillary cymes (at the upper axils of the leaves). The flowers are 5-merous. The calyx-tube is cup-shaped, 5-lobed. The sepals are ovate with an acute apex, they are 1.5 mm long and 1 mm wide. The calyx is light green and pubescent. The corolla is composed of 5 light green-coloured and glabrous petals. The petals are orbicular and clawed, about 1 mm long and 0.5 mm wide. The androecium is composed of 5 stamens. The filaments are 0.6-0.7 mm long with globose anthers at the tip. They are inserted at the base of a nectariferous disc . There are 2 connate, short and stout styles with simple stigmas at the end. The ovary is globose and 2-celled. The buds are covered with rusty hairs. The flowers are fragrant.
flower.text_html:

The flowers are 5-merous.

The ovary is globose and 2-celled.

leaf.text: The leaves of Ziziphus oenopolia grow alternately on the stem. The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and pubescent (rusty hairs). The leaves have a 5-6 mm long petiole . The leaf of Ziziphus oenopolia is 3-4 cm long and 2-3 cm wide. The shape of the blade is obliquely-ovate, the apex is acute-acuminate, the base is oblique and rounded and the margins are slightly serrate and hairy. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with 3 prominent veins.

habit.text: Ziziphus oenopolia is a very thorny, large-sized, deciduous and climbing shrub .

ecology.text: Ziziphus oenopolia is found in thickets, scrub jungles, forest edges and deciduous slopes from the coastal plains up to 1200 m high in the hills.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Ziziphus oenopolia is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Ziziphus oenopolia is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Ziziphus oenopolia are dispersed by various fruit-eating birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Ziziphus oenopolia is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Ziziphus oenopolia is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Ziziphus oenopolia are dispersed by various fruit-eating birds and mammals.

medicinal.text: Ziziphus oenopolia is used in Ayurveda and Siddha medicines. The fruits are digestive and stomachic. The bark is antiplasmodial, antimycobacterial, febrifuge, digestive and tonic. It is used for healing wounds and stomachache. The root bark decoction is used to treat fresh wounds. The root paste mixed with water is given for abdominal pain. The root is also a remedy against hyperacidity and ascaris infection. Sources : - Arya Vaidya Sala, 1996, Indian Medicinal plants - Basu & Kirtikar, 1918, Indian Medicinal Plants - Chopra, 1956, Glossary of Indian medicinal plants - Khare, 2007, Indian Medicinal Plants, An Illustrated Dictionary - Quattrocchi, 2012, CRC World Dictionary of Medicinal and Poisonous Plants

reforestation.text: Ziziphus oenopolia is a fast growing species and it is able to flourish in a wide range of soils but all soils need to be free draining. It thrives in open areas. The species is propagated by seeds. Acid treatment and 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Ziziphus oenopolia is a fast growing species and it is able to flourish in a wide range of soils but all soils need to be free draining. It thrives in open areas.
    The species is propagated by seeds.

  • Seed treatments :

    Acid treatment and 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
